# Genesis Apocryphon Column 18 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 1QapGen (Cave 1), Col. 18 | **Condition:** Nearly destroyed; only scattered words survive

---

**18:1** [...] Abram [...] went-out [...] from-Ur of-the-Chaldeans [...]

**18:2** [...] and-he-came to-Haran [...] and-he-dwelt there [...]

**18:3** [...] Terah his-father [...] and-Lot the-son-of Haran [...]

**18:4** [...] and-Sarai his-wife [...] and-all their-possessions [...]

**18:5** [...] and-God said to-Abram [...] go-out from-your-land [...]

**18:6** [...] and-from your-kindred [...] to-the-land which I-shall-show-you [...]

**18:7** [...] and-I-shall-make-you a-great-nation [...] and-I-shall-bless-you [...]

**18:8** [...] and-Abram went-out [...] as the-LORD had-spoken to-him [...]

**18:9** [...] to-the-land of-Canaan [...] and-he-crossed-over [...]

**18:10** [...]

---

*EMET notes: Column 18 is nearly destroyed. Surviving fragments narrate Abraham's departure from Ur and Haran toward Canaan, paralleling Genesis 11:31-12:5 in Aramaic retelling. God's call to Abram echoes the lekh lekha ("go out") of Gen 12:1. Construct chains preserved with hyphens.*
